'''Barbaros''' was the captain of ''[[The Rat's Nest]]'', a ship crewed by the [[Bilgerats]]. Having stolen age-old secrets from [[Falrevere]], he sailed to the accursed island of [[Balor]] with his crew in search of treasure, anchoring on a small isle north of the mainland where they built [[Bilgerat Compound|a small compound]]. Along with [[Second Mate O'Donovan]], [[Moralis]], [[Framwin]] and [[Jade]], he ventured onto the island in order to unearth the treasure. However, they were ambushed by orcs of the [[Stormreaver clan]], and Barbaros and his entire party save for O'Donovan and Jade were dragged to [[Stormwrought Castle]].<ref>[[Logbook of The Rat's Nest]]</ref> Barbaros was killed by the orcs, and his body was later used to house the soul of [[Deathlord Tidebane]].<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1462715515360378940 Moriena from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] - "He's Deathlord Tidebane"</ref>
